rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=214, gs_n_gaussians=512, gs_n_iter=150, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_render=raster, gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_amp_init_max=0.05, gs_ssim_weight=0.25, gs_outer_wall_s=1080, rationale=iter-16 (search-20260619-01) — EMPTY-PATCH CEILING CONFIRMATION from BASE_ITER=10 run-best (SSIM 0.769672: 512 Gaussians, gs_n_iter=150, gs_ssim_weight=0.25, gs_amp_init_max=0.05, gs_render=raster, gs_init_from_fbp=True). SIX-BOX VERDICT: r2gaussian is REGIME-BOUNDED on dense 2304-view Mayo. SSIM flat at 0.7696 +/-0.0005 across iter-8..15 (8 iters). The gs_ssim_weight lever lifted SSIM 0.738->0.7696 but DROPPED PSNR 24.1->20.9 dB and raised RMSE — headroom is PSNR/RMSE-gated vs the near-complete LD-FBP floor (~0.808), so hr stayed pinned at 0 throughout. Splat representation (512 Gaussians, 0.003M params) is a lossy compression that cannot exceed the analytic baseline when the inverse is well-posed (full-view). Only untried lever is capacity (n_gaussians 512->1024) but it is bounded the SAME way — more splats still land below the FBP floor on PSNR, and 1024@150iter risks the 20-min wall over 214 slices. Ceiling genuinely exhausted; empty-patch confirms run-best.
